query: Commit what has been done since the last commit.
setup: Working tree has uncommitted changes touching three unrelated areas: a new feature in src/, a docs/ restructure, and a dependency lockfile bump
expected_behavior: Inspects git status and the actual diff before writing any commit message
Produces at least three separate commits, one per unrelated area, rather than a single commit
Each commit subject matches the style of the last ten commits in the repository log
Each commit message describes the behavior or intent, not a list of file names
Leaves the working tree clean and shows the resulting git log
